name: lorekeeper
description: Sistema para organizar universos narrativos y su continuidad.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @lorekeeper/shared && npm run build -w @lorekeeper/validation
scripts.dev: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:packages && dotenv -- concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lorekeeper/api" "npm run dev -w @lorekeeper/web"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lorekeeper/api && npm run build -w @lorekeeper/web
scripts.test: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
